import json, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/livesite/Documents/ChatGPT/rgnix')
work=Path('/tmp/rgnix-hyper-prepared-20260928')
before=Path('/tmp/rgnix-hyper-profile-20260928/rgnix-after')
after=work/'rgnix-after'
nginx='/tmp/rgnix-compare-20260927/nginx/sbin/nginx'
openresty='/tmp/rgnix-compare-20260927/openresty/bin/openresty'
common=['--nginx',nginx,'--openresty',openresty,'--plain-proxy','--cases','proxy-1k','--rounds','3','--seconds','10','--warmup','2','--workers','1','--origin-workers','1','--client-threads','1','--server-cpus','10','--client-cpus','2','--origin-cpus','6','--interleave','--rgnix-transport','hyper','--candidate-transport','hyper']
def run(name,first,second,engines,concurrency):
    output=work/f'{name}.json'
    command=['python3',str(root/'scripts/benchmark_compare.py'),*common,'--rgnix',str(first),'--candidate',str(second),'--engines',*engines,'--concurrency',*map(str,concurrency),'--work-dir',str(work/name),'--output',str(output)]
    subprocess.run(command,check=True)
    return json.loads(output.read_text())
def gate(data,nginx=False):
    gates={}
    for concurrency in [64,256]:
        samples=[r for r in data['runs'] if r['concurrency']==concurrency]
        if nginx:
            left=samples[::2];right=samples[1::2]
        else:
            left=[r for r in samples if r['engine']=='rgnix'];right=[r for r in samples if r['engine']=='candidate']
        pairs=[200*abs(a['rps']-b['rps'])/(a['rps']+b['rps']) for a,b in zip(left,right)]
        cvs=[100*statistics.stdev(r['rps'] for r in group)/statistics.mean(r['rps'] for r in group) for group in [left,right]]
        gates[concurrency]={'paired_difference_pct':pairs,'cv_pct':cvs,'passed':len(pairs)==3 and max(pairs+cvs)<=10 and all(r['errors']==0 for r in samples)}
    return gates
result={'rule':'At each concurrency: three pairs; all symmetric RPS differences and both sample CVs <=10%, zero errors. Compare only concurrency levels passing both product A/A gates and NGINX A/A. No retry or window selection.'}
result['before']=gate(run('aa-before',before,before,['rgnix','candidate'],[64,256]))
result['after']=gate(run('aa-after',after,after,['rgnix','candidate'],[64,256]))
product_pass=[c for c in [64,256] if result['before'][c]['passed'] and result['after'][c]['passed']]
if product_pass:
    result['nginx']=gate(run('aa-nginx',after,after,['nginx','nginx'],[64,256]),True)
    valid=[c for c in product_pass if result['nginx'][c]['passed']]
    if valid:
        run('comparison',before,after,['rgnix','candidate','nginx'],valid)
        result['comparison_concurrency']=valid
else:result['comparison_concurrency']=[]
(work/'calibration.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
